claim: The court-dance tracking policy (court-dance-g1-16k, model_1999), judged on 40 paired trials under its tracking task (pushes as in training, observation noise, the start pose drawn as in training, a command lag drawn per trial in [0, 20] ms), danced the whole 21.9 s clip in 18 of 40 trials, exact 95% interval [0.29, 0.62]. The lag decides it: with no lag 17 of 19 trials succeeded, with one 20 ms control tick of lag 1 of 21. mjlab's tracking task does not randomize action delay in training, and this policy does not tolerate one tick of it.
instrument: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti, 24,564 MiB, driver 610.88, WSL2 (Linux 6.18.58.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2); mjlab-1.6.0+mujoco-3.13.0+warp-1.17.0+cuda through trainnr_mjlab.tracking_verdict (the feat/tracking-evaluation branch over 3bda0a3), the Studio open and receiving world 0

inputs.policy: court-dance-g1-16k-model_1999@163008272be4, the checkpoint of the record g1-court-dance-tracked-2026-11-17
inputs.task: court-dance-tracking = g1-tracking@49b188d532d9 (accepted: 64 worlds, 2 PPO iterations on the reference)

artifacts.runs/court-dance-g1-16k/verdict: walk-verdict-tracking-push-lag20-cuda.json, records-tracking-push-lag20-cuda.jsonl (one EpisodeRecord per trial), evaluation.rrd (world 0) in the g1-dance test project
artifacts.certificates/court-dance-g1-16k-model_19: the evaluation as the project imported it, citing the policy, the task and the run

protocol: mjlab's play mode for the whole clip from frame 0 (no time limit), with training's conditions put back: observation noise on, the start pose and velocity drawn in training's ranges, mjlab's push_robot event. 40 worlds, seed 1000, one trial per world. Each trial's lag is drawn uniformly over whole control ticks in [0, round(20 ms x 50 Hz)] = {0, 1} from the seed; the policy's action reaches the robot that many ticks late. Success: the clip played to its end with no termination (mjlab's tracking terminations: the anchor's height and orientation, the end effectors' height, against the reference). Interval: exact Clopper-Pearson.
caveats: One policy, one seed for the trials, one reference: a measurement of this checkpoint, not of the method.
The lag split is 19 against 21 trials drawn by the seed, not a designed pair; the gap (17/19 against 1/21) is wide enough to read, the exact numbers are not.
Lag is whole 20 ms ticks: 1 to 19 ms of delay are not modelled.
Simulation only: no G1 to deploy to (docs/86 §9).
